analysis.summary: TEMPORARY CANNED RESPONSE — no observability agent was called. The job failed because the entrypoint exited with RAY_JOB_ENTRYPOINT_COMMAND_ERROR after the cluster came up; the plasma store was unused and no actors were registered, so the failure happened before the workload started.
